subject.title: fix(imessage): repair DM sender fallback before pairing

question: Should this PR only repair confidently recoverable DM senders with canonical iMessage normalization, or should it also fail-closed for unrecoverable local-sender DM payloads before access control?
rationale: The sender value is the authorization subject and reply target, so deciding whether ambiguous unrepaired payloads may continue downstream is a security-boundary policy choice rather than a formatting detail.

options.title: Normalize Candidates And Prove The Live Path
options.body: Require canonical handle comparison, focused regression coverage, and redacted after-fix proof before considering the branch mergeable.

options.title: Add A Fail-Closed Guard Here
options.body: Extend the PR to drop unrecoverable non-group inbound DMs whose sender canonicalizes to destination_caller_id before access control sees them.

options.title: Pause For A Narrower Issue
options.body: If the author's remaining failures are a different root cause, pause this branch and track the separate iMessage identity bug elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Normalize Candidates And Prove The Live Path
recommendation.body: Require canonical handle comparison, focused regression coverage, and redacted after-fix proof before considering the branch mergeable.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent iMessage target-normalization and inbound-policy refactors make this the best available routing owner for the security-boundary choice.
